data.one_liner: Gets network type, carrier codes, and SIM info on Android and iOS.
data.what_it_does: Retrieves mobile network details, SIM insertion status, signal strength, and operator information from Android and iOS devices. It uses Pigeon for platform communication and provides unified summaries as well as platform-specific info.
use_when: You need to detect network generation like 5G or LTE in your app.
You need to read SIM card details or check if a SIM is inserted.
You need device carrier network codes and country codes.
avoid_when: You target iOS 16.0+ and strictly require carrier names and country codes, which Apple has deprecated.
You are building a web or desktop application.
strengths: Provides a unified summary method across both Android and iOS.
Supports dual-SIM and eSIM information retrieval.
Gracefully handles missing permissions by returning empty fields rather than failing.
weaknesses: iOS 16.0+ deprecates carrier-specific info like carrier name and country codes due to platform limitations.
Requires platform-specific permission setups and runtime requests.
data.setup_notes: Requires adding permissions to AndroidManifest.xml (such as READ_PHONE_STATE, ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION) and requesting runtime permissions.
